Maria: Quick morning async — cut lane status: canary 1/1 passed perf smoke but we saw 15% latency tail on long prompts.
Devon: Noted. Did the canary hit the new batching config?
Maria: yes, enabled `batcher.v2` with max_batch=32. Tail seems correlated with requests >1024 tokens.
Alice: FYI I pushed a tiny change to model routing that might avoid long-context allocation on small hosts — #4821. Needs a quick review.
Devon: I can review in 20m. If it's small we can merge before midday cut.
Sam: Heads-up — k8s node replacement on eu-west cluster at 11:30UTC, affects dedicated pools. I scheduled a 15m maintenance window.
Maria: thanks @Sam, we'll avoid scheduling high-throughput canaries then.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary deployment 2026-03-17T10:05:43Z started for release/2026-03-17-canary-1
Maria: Blocker: one cherry-pick from #4798 failed due to proto change; I left a note in the PR, pinged @Alice for proto guidance.
Alice: looking now — the proto bump is safe but needs a generated code update. I can push the generated files in a follow-up commit.
Devon: also, running low on preemptible GPU quota for Dedicated pool for the evening run. @Sam can we request an increase or fallback plan?
Sam: I'll open a ticket with infra; short-term fallback is to route some jobs to cpu-worker tier with quantized model (slower but works).
Maria: plan for today: merge #4821 if Devon approves, reattempt cherry-pick after Alice's gen, monitor tail latency and try `batcher.v2` tweak (max_batch->24) if we see regressions, and avoid eu-west heavy traffic during maintenance.
Devon: on PR review now, ETA 25m.
Alice: will push generated files in 15m, will ping here when done.
infra-bot: [ticket] INF-1324 created for GPU quota request by Sam
Maria: thanks all — leave quick thumbs up when you see the follow-ups so I can close the loop. :thumbsup:
Devon: 👍
Alice: 👍
Sam: 👍
